# Host configs (docs/host-config.md): what ta_host_create takes, and the
# error it writes for a config it refuses. Run by the suite's runner.
#
# A case is a line "config <name>", then:
#   cbor <hex>        the config
#   error <hex>       ta_host_create refuses it and writes this error
#   ok                ta_host_create takes it; then, on the new host:
#   send <hex>        a request, and
#   reply <hex>       its reply
#   diag <text>       the hex line before it, in diagnostic notation
#   only reference    bytes a binding cannot send: run by the reference
#                     (ta-conform) alone (README.md, "Envelope-level cases")
# A config's error has no "id": it answers no request.

config the least: a system id
cbor a16873797374656d49446168
diag {"systemID":"h"}
ok
send a262696401666d6574686f646a6163746f722e6c697374
diag {"id":1,"method":"actor.list"}
reply a26269640166726573756c74a26873657373696f6e738066637572736f72f6
diag {"id":1,"result":{"sessions":[],"cursor":null}}
